manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Anikthea either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Three Blind Mice from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 3/3 Zombie in addition to their other types.
The Three Blind Mice token enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to its read-ahead ability, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat step 3.
